_doc: Underlyings Omni lists as both a perpetual and a swap. A pair is accepted when the two share Variational's symbol, or when the docs name the same reference market for both (TradFi Perpetuals > Index Prices; Swaps > Instrument Reference). Reviewed against the listings in the stored snapshots on 2026-11-22.

pairs.label: Gold
pairs.basis: Same symbol. Perpetual: gold spot price. Swap: spot gold (XAU/USD).

pairs.label: Silver
pairs.basis: Same symbol. Perpetual: silver spot price. Swap: spot silver (XAG/USD).

pairs.label: WTI crude
pairs.basis: Perpetual: WTI Crude Oil futures. Swap: NYMEX WTI Crude Oil futures (CME.CL).

pairs.label: Brent crude
pairs.basis: Perpetual: Brent Crude Oil futures. Swap: ICE Brent Crude futures (ICE.BRN).

pairs.label: Copper
pairs.basis: Perpetual: COMEX High Grade Copper futures. Swap: COMEX Copper futures (CME.HG).

pairs.label: S&P 500
pairs.basis: Same symbol and same index, different reference instrument. Perpetual: 'an ETF composed of a basket of the leading 500 US stocks', priced at a tenth of the index. Swap: CME E-mini S&P 500 futures (CME.ES).

rejected.reason: Different symbols; the perpetual is on the Invesco QQQ Trust share, the swap on CME E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures.

no_counterpart.note: The docs' swap reference also lists XPT, XPD, NTGAS and EURUSD swaps; none is in the API yet. When one appears, add the pair here.
